Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, VampC...@AOL.COM wrote:
> 1: Contesting with yourself - you burn a pool next turn
> right?

You have choices:
1) you can yield both copies. (cost: 0)
2) you can contest both copies. (cost: 2)
3) you can yield one and contest the other (cost: 1)
in this case, you'll get the one that you are contesting
back on your *following* untap phase. [4.1]

> 2: Final round tourney seating order: does the first
> place guy get to place himself in between any other
> players? What about the players before him?

Yes and yes.

> 3: Blood Doll gives blood to the current controller of
> the vampire, right?

Blood Doll - Master

* The Methuselah controlling the Vampire gets the
benefit of the Blood Doll. [RTR 950413]
